prompt.en: Which province was the first to grant voting rights to women, in 1916?
prompt.fr: Quelle province a été la première à accorder le droit de vote aux femmes, en 1916?

explanation.en: Manitoba opened the ballot box to women in 1916, ahead of every other province. Quebec was the last to follow, in 1940.
explanation.fr: Le Manitoba a ouvert l'urne aux femmes en 1916, avant toutes les autres provinces. Le Québec a été le dernier à suivre, en 1940.

source.quote: In 1916, Manitoba became the first province to grant voting rights to women.
